answer: In an EigenTrust network, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so past service loses influence unless honest behavior is sustained. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust: a newcomer cannot gain durable centrality merely through mutual endorsements. Fresh identities such as oasis, pearl, and zephyr therefore begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot meet consensus thresholds without accumulating credible, persistent interactions.
